name: Wildcard: Sudden Doom procs from any direct damage ability or spell (#12527)
contract: Sudden Doom rank 3 (49530) reads 'Direct damage abilities and spells have a 9% chance to cast a free Grave Coil
at your target.' The spell_proc row -49018 kept the stock Death Knight family mask (Blood Strike and Heart Strike
only) and the DBC melee-ability flag, so a Wildcard hero without those strikes never procced it, and no spell
could. The row now accepts direct ability and spell damage of every family. aura_proc_rate replays the aura's
full native proc decision 40000 times: about 9% for a Mage Fire Blast (2136) and a Warrior Heroic Strike (78),
zero for an auto attack and for a periodic Corruption tick (172). Before the fix both direct rates read 0.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: the Sudden Doom talent is active
CONTRACT (#12527): a direct damage spell from another class procs about 9%
CONTRACT (#12527): a melee ability that is not Blood or Heart Strike procs about 9%
CONTROL: an auto attack is not a direct damage ability
CONTROL: a periodic tick is not direct damage
